# The tables the auth service creates in the auth schema (excalibase-auth, internal/migrate/migrations/postgres,
# plus golang-migrate's schema_migrations). platformServiceSchemas must list exactly these: a table missing from it
# is refused, not reclaimed, when a customer role comes to own it. Update this file with the auth migrations.

audit_log
auth_codes
email_change_tokens

email_verification_tokens
flow_states
guest_lock
guest_sign_ups
identities
mfa_challenges
mfa_factors
mfa_failures
mfa_recovery_codes
password_reset_tokens
refresh_tokens
role_changes
schema_migrations
users
